children.text: In the opening sequence of this video, the rhetor establishes credibility by stating her credentials “a soon to be second-year medical student at Harvard.” Since Harvard is considered the number one medical school in America and a regarded Ivy League school, the prestige of the institution may grab the attention of viewers who are aware of this. She speaks in a very calm voice, immediately revealing the content of the video, which displays her “Day in my Life,” a popular type of trend video on TikTok. Because the “Day in my Life” videos are generally favored by viewers, the algorithm may promote this video to a wider audience outside of her regular follower count. Along with this voiceover, she includes video content that follows the traditional style of the “Day in my Life” trend, including making her bed and beginning a morning skincare routine.

The rhetor displays clips of herself putting makeup on, which is a common video clip to include in “Day in my Life” or “Get Ready with Me” videos. Users who are interested in achieving the beauty standard and a similar look to the influencer may be interested in her makeup routine and the products that she generally uses. She employs platform affordances by linking these products on her shop my in a folder called “makeup routine:),” linked in her TikTok bio. Ethical implications come into play here, because although she is promoting non-medical products her position as a medical student may imply scientific validation that does not exist. In addition, the medical field is a largely general profession that encompasses much of modern life, so it is difficult to define a hard line between medical and non-medical products. For example, skincare and cosmetics may be implicated under the umbrella of dermatology.

Towards the end of the video Melissa alludes to the future, referring to “some exciting upcoming projects.” This direct reference to the future while being covert about the subject encourages followers to stay engaged with her content, or non-followers to follow her in order to see what these future projects entail. With this voiceover, she displays video content of her working on a computer in fast motion with a listed time frame of about two hours. This marketing strategy targets human curiosity by leaving an information gap to trigger followers to wonder what it will be, causing them to feel a greater, more exclusive connection to her by knowing that she is working on an upcoming project that will be revealed to all viewers in the future.

At the very end of the video, Melissa displays her wind-down nighttime routine, stating “by now I was exhausted.” She gives specific products features via short video clips, including Amika haircare and Tatcha moisturizer. In an earlier video clip, you can see her unboxed PR packages, some including these products. The companies are also tagged in the caption of her TikTok. By giving these products screentime, Melissa is advertising PR that has been sent to her without directly stating this. By including them in her nighttime routine, she implies that these products help her unwind and go to sleep, encouraging the audience to purchase these products if they want the same wind-down experience. While not being explicitly an advertising video, it includes elements of advertising certain products. She utilizes platform affordances by listing these Amika shampoo and conditioner on her shop my in a folder called “hair care,” linked in her TikTok bio. These products are also included in her Amazon Storefront in a folder called “Hair Essentials,” also linked in her TikTok bio. Ethical implications may be considered here for the same reasons as listed above.

Qin communicates a sense of authenticity by incorporating humor and sarcasm into her voiceover. She makes the statement “I literally landed less than 24 hours ago, so this is me trying to get my life together.” This use of verbiage makes her appear more relatable to young viewers, most likely students within the healthcare field with packed schedules. Anyone who has just returned from vacation, especially an audience that may fit this description, has felt the sense of urgency to get back to their daily life and attend to what they have missed while being away. The use of the phrase “getting my life together” also alludes to a popular aesthetic throughout internet culture, which idolizes organization, routines, and productivity.
